name: South Sudan

elections.note: Presidency, National Legislative Assembly and Council of States.

summary: South Sudan has never held a national election since independence in 2011; the vote has been postponed repeatedly since 2015. Main opposition leader Riek Machar has been under arrest and on trial since 2025.
